subject: Kickoff: FM4TLP transfer benchmark track
body:
Team — kicking off the FM4TLP track for graphs-retrieval.

The work benchmarks transferring an inductive temporal link prediction model from a training graph to a test graph with zero node overlap — precisely the cold-start problem our graph products hit whenever we onboard a new domain: no shared nodes, only structure. Goal: establish whether transfer-based TLP can replace per-domain training in our recommendation stack.

Milestones: (1) env bring-up by Mar 20 — nontrivial, the repo needs a conda graph-tool environment with a pinned torch 2.3.0/cu118 stack and some documented python-binary oddities; (2) reproduce the benchmark transfer results by end of April; (3) run the transfer protocol on two internal graph domains in June; (4) recommendation readout by Jul 10.

Rosa owns infra, Ondrej modeling, Gustavo experiments, Bilal data plumbing. Daniela follows up on resourcing.

Anders
